# Implementation Plan: App Branding and Design System

**Branch**: `009-app-design-system` | **Date**: 2026-07-30 | **Spec**: [spec.md](file:///c:/Users/markc/_Projects/micro-controller/smartflow/specs/009-app-design-system/spec.md)

**Note**: This plan is generated by `/speckit-plan`. See `.specify/templates/plan-template.md` for the execution workflow.

---

## Summary

The goal is to implement a robust and consistent Android App Design System using Jetpack Compose, based on the provided Brand Identity Package. This includes applying the core brand colors (Primary Blue `#0EA5E9`, Secondary Green `#10B981`, Background `#0F172A`, Accent White `#FFFFFF`) and typography (Inter / Roboto) across all app screens, ensuring adherence to Material Design 3 guidelines.

## Phase 3: App Implementation

**Build command**: `.\gradlew.bat assembleDebug`

### Implementation
- [ ] [APP-001] Download and add `Inter` and `Roboto` font files to `app/src/main/res/font/`.
- [ ] [APP-002] Update `app/src/main/java/com/smartflow/ui/theme/Color.kt` with Brand Identity colors.
- [ ] [APP-003] Update `app/src/main/java/com/smartflow/ui/theme/Type.kt` to use the new fonts.
- [ ] [APP-004] Update `app/src/main/java/com/smartflow/ui/theme/Theme.kt` to define Light and Dark `ColorScheme`s.
- [ ] [APP-005] Update existing screens to use `MaterialTheme.colorScheme` and `MaterialTheme.typography` instead of hardcoded values.

**Checkpoint**: `.\gradlew.bat assembleDebug` succeeds, app UI reflects new theme.
